front.title: POC: Path Traversal and Sensitive File Access

abstract.t: This POC tests various path traversal techniques and attempts to access highly sensitive files including SSH keys, cloud credentials, and shadow passwords.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: This proof of concept demonstrates advanced exploitation techniques including relative path traversal and file:// URI schemes.

section.name: Attack Techniques
section.t: This POC tests the following techniques:

ol.li: file:// URI scheme for absolute paths

section.name: High-Value Targets
section.t: Attackers typically target these sensitive files:

ul.li: Application-specific config files with database credentials

ol.li: Upgrade to xml2rfc version 3.30.2 or later immediately
Run xml2rfc in a sandboxed environment with limited file access
Implement file access monitoring and alerting
Apply principle of least privilege to the xml2rfc process
